<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (tenets 1-6). This repo: Rust crates are the boundaries (crates/core types · crates/store adapter · crates/daemon http/composition root; arch-allowlist checked by `harness checks`); the pi extension lives in .pi/extensions/pij with core/ pi-free and fakes-tested (session.ts), adapters/ holding the runtime seams (rust-runtime.ts, daemon-http.ts). THE ONE FACT THIS PLAN MOVES: who knows a boot is fresh. Today the extension infers it from 'no row exists' (true under legacy, false under rs). After: the daemon states it. Vocabulary (frozen): `binding` = `created` (no row existed) | `rebound` (row existed, proc.pid/proc_start differ from stored) | `same` (row existed, same proc). fresh := binding !== 'same'. Extras-first: `binding` is an added optional field on the register response; nothing renamed. Seams: (1) crates/store registry put → must surface inserted-vs-updated + previous proc (pre-read inside the same transaction, or RETURNING with a CASE); (2) crates/daemon http register → sets binding; (3) core/daemon-wire.ts RustSeatDescriptor.binding?; (4) rust-runtime.ts boot passes `fresh` into session.boot; (5) core/session.ts BootInput.fresh?: boolean, `fresh = input.fresh ?? (liveDescriptor===null || wasDissolved)`. Golden fixture assets/contracts/register-response.json is the shared artifact both suites assert against (cross-runtime literal seam rule).

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| r1 | rebound detection needs the PREVIOUS proc; a put that only returns changes() cannot tell rebound from same — retire by pre-reading the row inside the same write transaction (persist-before-mutate holds). |
| r2 | Old daemon + new extension: binding absent → undefined → today's inference. Covered by u2's undefined branch test. |
| r3 | Spawn pre-mints the row, so a spawned seat's extension register is always `rebound`/`same`, never `created` — fresh must be true for rebound (proc differs from the spawner's placeholder) — assert this specific case in u1 (placeholder proc vs real proc) and in the live AC1. |
| r4 | Daemon not restarted after the Rust change → fix invisible, greens honest. Compose step 3 is mandatory and its pid/ping output is part of done. |
